title: Pingdin — Tenant Operational Signals (de-identified, all tiers)

panels.title: Activity volume, trailing 7-day window (core.signal_ledger, tenant_operational_volume)

targets.rawSql: SELECT computed_at AS time, tenant_id::text AS metric, (value->>'activity_count')::numeric AS "activity_count" FROM core.signal_ledger WHERE signal_key = 'tenant_operational_volume' AND subject_token IS NULL AND computed_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ('$tenant_id' = '' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') ORDER BY computed_at

panels.description: One line per tenant. subject_token IS NULL is what makes this a tenant/agent-level aggregate (migration core/091) rather than a per-person row -- this panel can never show which specific person generated any of this activity, only the tenant's own trailing-7-day count. Computed nightly by capabilities/signals/operational.py, same cron slot as every other production signal.

panels.title: Latest reading per tenant

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (sl.tenant_id) t.name AS tenant_name, sl.tenant_id, sl.agent_key, (sl.value->>'activity_count')::int AS activity_count, (sl.value->>'message_count')::int AS message_count, (sl.value->>'active_subject_count')::int AS active_subject_count, sl.computed_at FROM core.signal_ledger sl JOIN core.tenant t ON t.id = sl.tenant_id WHERE sl.signal_key = 'tenant_operational_volume' AND sl.subject_token IS NULL AND ('$tenant_id' = '' OR sl.tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') ORDER BY sl.tenant_id, sl.computed_at DESC

panels.description: One row per tenant, most recent computed_at only -- a quick 'is anyone gone quiet' scan. A tenant that stops appearing here (or whose activity_count drops to zero) is exactly the signal this dashboard exists to surface, without ever showing what any individual message said or who sent it.
